_note: Overhaul v3 review pool (engineering 3.2.4, blueprint 3.5 and 6.3). Every featured Google text was re-read on the live Google listing on 2026-10-31 and replaced with the reviewer's exact words (the earlier texts, carried over from the live site, were reworded, spliced or partly invented; two were not on Google at all). verified_on is that date. Templates print a review ONLY when platform is google AND featurable is true (lib/eleventy-ws5.js featured(), which throws if a template asks for a non-Google text). featurable false carries the reason from blueprint 6.3 or status.md. Yelp reviews are recorded by name only, with no text, so Yelp wording can never reach a page (Yelp Terms 5.3 and 7.2.9, status.md standing risk). verified_on stays null until someone re-reads that review on the live Google listing (blueprint 3.2: every one re-read on Google before use); month_year stays null because no file records it. stars: the star rating that person gave on Google (1 to 5), with stars_checked_on the date someone read it on the live listing; a review shows stars ONLY when both are set, never a guess and never the listing average (Chase 2026-10-31: add the star rating the person gave us). services: which lanes a review may appear in (car, home, blinds, chip, windshield, commercial, ceramic, clearbra, general).
